design.decision: Bid low and duck: every overtrick your team takes is a trick the opponents don't, so make exactly your contract and give away the rest; it also multiplies a made nil.
design.opponent: Revealed on the first trick they win; opponents may decline cheap tricks or try to push extra tricks onto your team.
design.rationale: Exact lacks a rare that isn't just a bigger amount on an existing uncommon; this pays the Exact idea (no overtricks) a little at a time instead of all at once, pairs with Nil, and applies on sets so low bids still carry risk.
design.draftText: +2 contract multiplier when the opponents win a trick
design.hooks: New trigger scope `whose: opponents` on win triggers: counts tricks any player on the opposing team wins, as a general mirror of every win trigger.

critic.concerns: Opponents can't avoid winning the tricks they need, so their only response is ducking overtricks; in practice it is close to a flat +mult that rewards low bids.
